title: CortexOps golden dataset (format v1)
description: Golden eval dataset read by the Python SDK (EvalSuite / cortexops eval run) and the TypeScript SDK (EvalSuite / cortexops-js eval run). Usually written as YAML; unknown keys are ignored by both SDKs.

version.description: Dataset version, stored as dataset_version on eval runs.

project.description: CortexOps project the results belong to.

name.description: Dataset name; when set, the CLI uploads a dataset snapshot with --push.

id.description: Case identifier (numbers are converted to strings).

input.description: Agent input: a string is passed as {"input": <string>}, a mapping as-is.

expected_tool_calls.description: Tool names the agent should call (order-insensitive). Scored by tool_accuracy.

expected_output_contains.description: Case-insensitive substrings the output must contain. Scored by task_completion.

expected_output_not_contains.description: Case-insensitive substrings the output must not contain.

max_latency_ms.description: Latency budget for the case; exceeding it lowers the latency score.

judge.description: "llm" adds the LLM-judge metric (offline heuristic in the TypeScript SDK).
